# STD Notation and Claim Table

| Role | Canonical spelling | Unit/domain | Sole permitted meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Real numerator | `m_MAP(p)` | Signal unit; exact immutable ordinary MAP domain | Corresponding all-`+1` normalized real-observation MAP signal. |
| Conditional scale | `sigma_cond(p)=sqrt(Vhat_cond(p))` | Signal unit; exact finite-positive conditional-second-moment domain | Positive denominator derived from the declared conditional target. |
| Standardized product | `zeta_cond(p)=m_MAP(p)/sigma_cond(p)` | Unit exactly `1`; compatible finite-positive intersection | "MAP signal standardized by the stated conditional detector-sign-randomization second-moment scale." |

Inactive r0.1 `q_MAP`, `V_hat_cond`, and `S_cond` spellings are change-map
history only. `zeta_cond` is not Gaussian, Student, pivotal, z, N-sigma,
probability, detection, false-alarm rate, completeness, purity, or catalog
authority. JINC remains separate and unavailable.
